label: 侧坐后撑 / 人鱼坐
pose_lead: Grounded pose, mermaid side-sit with rear support:
lower_limbs: Both legs bend and gather to one side of the body, one thigh angling forward while the other leg folds behind, the calves lying close together.
upper_limbs: Both arms reach behind the body, palms pressing the ground, elbows almost straight.
torso_head: The chest lifts upward and the waist arches slightly back; the head rises and turns toward the upper side.
weight_silhouette: Weight rests mainly on the hips and both hands, the body tracing an S-line from lifted chest through arched waist to legs spreading sideways.
